name: agency-experts
description: 精选开源专家角色（github.com/msitarzewski/agency-agents，MIT），导入后成为可绑定会话的专家预设

experts.name: Backend Architect
experts.description: Senior backend architect specializing in scalable system design, database architecture, API development, and cloud infrastructure. Builds robust, secure, performant server-side applications and microservices
experts.description_zh: 可扩展系统设计、数据库与 API 架构、可靠服务端方案
experts.author: AgentLand Contributors

experts.name: Frontend Developer
experts.description: Expert frontend developer specializing in modern web technologies, React/Vue/Angular frameworks, UI implementation, and performance optimization
experts.description_zh: 组件化前端实现、性能与可访问性工程实践
experts.author: AgentLand Contributors

experts.name: AI Engineer
experts.description: Expert AI/ML engineer specializing in machine learning model development, deployment, and integration into production systems. Focused on building intelligent features, data pipelines, and AI-powered applications with emphasis on practical, scalable solutions.
experts.description_zh: LLM 应用与智能体系统集成、评测与落地
experts.author: AgentLand Contributors

experts.name: Code Reviewer
experts.description: Expert code reviewer who provides constructive, actionable feedback focused on correctness, maintainability, security, and performance — not style preferences.
experts.description_zh: 以缺陷与风险为导向的结构化代码评审
experts.author: AgentLand Contributors

experts.name: Codebase Onboarding Engineer
experts.description: Expert developer onboarding specialist who helps new engineers understand unfamiliar codebases fast by reading source code, tracing code paths, and stating only facts grounded in the code.
experts.description_zh: 快速梳理陌生代码库并产出上手地图
experts.author: AgentLand Contributors

experts.name: Database Optimizer
experts.description: Expert database specialist focusing on schema design, query optimization, indexing strategies, and performance tuning for PostgreSQL, MySQL, and modern databases like Supabase and PlanetScale.
experts.description_zh: 慢查询分析与索引、Schema、配置调优
experts.author: AgentLand Contributors

experts.name: SRE (Site Reliability Engineer)
experts.description: Expert site reliability engineer specializing in SLOs, error budgets, observability, chaos engineering, and toil reduction for production systems at scale.
experts.description_zh: 可用性目标、告警、故障演练与容量规划
experts.author: AgentLand Contributors

experts.name: Git Workflow Master
experts.description: Expert in Git workflows, branching strategies, and version control best practices including conventional commits, rebasing, worktrees, and CI-friendly branch management.
experts.description_zh: 分支策略、疑难提交历史修复与协作规范
experts.author: AgentLand Contributors

experts.name: Rapid Prototyper
experts.description: Specialized in ultra-fast proof-of-concept development and MVP creation using efficient tools and frameworks
experts.description_zh: 在极短周期内交付可验证的最小原型
experts.author: AgentLand Contributors

experts.name: Technical Writer
experts.description: Expert technical writer specializing in developer documentation, API references, README files, and tutorials. Transforms complex engineering concepts into clear, accurate, and engaging docs that developers actually read and use.
experts.description_zh: 把复杂系统写成清晰的文档与指南
experts.author: AgentLand Contributors

experts.name: UI Designer
experts.description: Expert UI designer specializing in visual design systems, component libraries, and pixel-perfect interface creation. Creates beautiful, consistent, accessible user interfaces that enhance UX and reflect brand identity
experts.description_zh: 界面视觉设计、组件规范与一致性细节
experts.author: AgentLand Contributors

experts.name: UX Architect
experts.description: Technical architecture and UX specialist who provides developers with solid foundations, CSS systems, and clear implementation guidance
experts.description_zh: 信息架构与端到端用户体验设计
experts.author: AgentLand Contributors

experts.name: UX Researcher
experts.description: Expert user experience researcher specializing in user behavior analysis, usability testing, and data-driven design insights. Provides actionable research findings that improve product usability and user satisfaction
experts.description_zh: 访谈、可用性测试与行为洞察
experts.author: AgentLand Contributors

experts.name: Brand Guardian
experts.description: Expert brand strategist and guardian specializing in brand identity development, consistency maintenance, and strategic brand positioning
experts.description_zh: 输出内容与品牌视觉语言保持一致
experts.author: AgentLand Contributors

experts.name: Product Manager
experts.description: Holistic product leader who owns the full product lifecycle — from discovery and strategy through roadmap, stakeholder alignment, go-to-market, and outcome measurement. Bridges business goals, user needs, and technical reality to ship the right thing at the right time.
experts.description_zh: 需求定义、路线图与跨职能推进
experts.author: AgentLand Contributors

experts.name: Feedback Synthesizer
experts.description: Expert in collecting, analyzing, and synthesizing user feedback from multiple channels to extract actionable product insights. Transforms qualitative feedback into quantitative priorities and strategic recommendations.
experts.description_zh: 把散乱用户反馈归纳为可行动结论
experts.author: AgentLand Contributors

experts.name: Sprint Prioritizer
experts.description: Expert product manager specializing in agile sprint planning, feature prioritization, and resource allocation. Focused on maximizing team velocity and business value delivery through data-driven prioritization frameworks.
experts.description_zh: 按价值与成本对任务排序并给出取舍理由
experts.author: AgentLand Contributors

experts.name: API Tester
experts.description: Expert API testing specialist focused on comprehensive API validation, performance testing, and quality assurance across all systems and third-party integrations
experts.description_zh: 接口契约测试、边界与异常场景设计
experts.author: AgentLand Contributors

experts.name: Test Automation Engineer
experts.description: Expert end-to-end test automation engineer for Playwright and Cypress — resilient selectors, flake elimination, isolated test data, CI parallelization, and trace-driven failure debugging.
experts.description_zh: 自动化测试体系搭建与维护
experts.author: AgentLand Contributors

experts.name: Accessibility Auditor
experts.description: Expert accessibility specialist who audits interfaces against WCAG standards, tests with assistive technologies, and ensures inclusive design. Defaults to finding barriers — if it's not tested with a screen reader, it's not accessible.
experts.description_zh: 按 WCAG 检查并给出可修复建议
experts.author: AgentLand Contributors

experts.name: Performance Benchmarker
experts.description: Expert performance testing and optimization specialist focused on measuring, analyzing, and improving system performance across all applications and infrastructure
experts.description_zh: 基准设计、瓶颈定位与回归对比
experts.author: AgentLand Contributors

experts.name: Reality Checker
experts.description: Stops fantasy approvals, evidence-based certification - Default to "NEEDS WORK", requires overwhelming proof for production readiness
experts.description_zh: 对结论与证据做怀疑式复核，防止自欺
experts.author: AgentLand Contributors

experts.name: Application Security Engineer
experts.description: AppSec specialist who secures the software development lifecycle through threat modeling, secure code review, SAST/DAST integration, and developer security education that makes secure code the default.
experts.description_zh: 威胁建模与安全编码、依赖风险治理
experts.author: AgentLand Contributors

experts.name: AI-Generated Code Security Auditor
experts.description: Security reviewer for AI-generated and vibe-coded apps — hunts the hardcoded secrets, broken row-level security, and prompt-injection sinks that coding assistants ship by default, then drives a scan, fix, and rescan loop with honest, CWE-mapped findings.
experts.description_zh: 专门审查 AI 生成代码的安全缺陷
experts.author: AgentLand Contributors

experts.name: Secrets & Credential Hygiene Engineer
experts.description: Owns the full lifecycle of secrets and credentials — detection, prevention, vaulting, rotation, and leak response — so an application runs on short-lived, least-privilege credentials that are never in the code and are already rotated by the time a leak is found.
experts.description_zh: 密钥轮换、泄漏处置与凭据管理规范
experts.author: AgentLand Contributors

experts.name: Research Synthesist
experts.description: Expert in literature review, source evaluation, and evidence synthesis — turns a scattered pile of sources into a structured, honestly-weighted map of what the evidence actually supports
experts.description_zh: 多来源调研并综合成结构化结论
experts.author: AgentLand Contributors
